question: Inhibition of 3-hydroxy-methylglutaryl-CoA reductase will produce:

options.opa: A reduction in the concentration of cholesterol.
options.opb: A reduction in the concentration of acetyl CoA.
options.opc: An increase in the concentration of steroid hormones.
options.opd: A reduction in the concentration of triacylglycerides.

analysis: Inhibition of 3-hydroxy-methylglutaryl-CoA reductase will lead to a reduction in the concentration of cholesterol as this enzyme is involved in the biosynthesis of cholesterol.
